# Sovereign X Audits
> Intelligence audit services for businesses, professionals, and creatives.
> Operated by BlackFur Capital Group LLC.
> All payments to BlackFur Capital Group LLC.

## About
Sovereign X Audits provides three core services:
1. Sovereign X Digital Audit — a 21-section business intelligence report
2. X Image Audit — an 18-section personal brand intelligence report
3. Voice Agent Services — ElevenLabs-powered voice agents for businesses

All deliverables are AICC Verified through the AI Council Conductor methodology.
Reports are delivered via Google Drive within 72 hours of intake completion.

## Services and Pricing

### Sovereign X Digital Audit
- Standard: $500 promotional / $750 regular
- Deep: $1,500 promotional / $2,000 regular
- Deep + Intake: $2,000 promotional / $2,500 regular
- Covers: 21 sections including technical performance, revenue leaks,
  NAP consistency, AI search visibility, reputation management,
  social media infrastructure, and AI readiness assessment
- Best for: law firms, dental practices, medical practices,
  med spas, real estate offices, CPAs, and any business
  where reputation equals revenue

### X Image Audit
- Standard: $350 promotional / $500 regular
- Public Figure Tier: $750 promotional / $1,000 regular
- X Attraction Audit: $350 promotional / $500 regular
- Covers: 18 sections including color analysis, social media audit,
  brand alignment, hair and grooming, outfit architecture,
  photography readiness, and personal presence
- Best for: professionals, creatives, executives, artists,
  content creators, athletes, public figures

### Voice Agent Services
- Starter: $1,500 setup + $200/month
- Standard: $2,500 setup + $350/month
- Advanced: $4,000–$5,000 setup + $500/month
- Powered by ElevenLabs Conversational AI
- Best for: businesses losing revenue to missed after-hours calls

## AICC Methodology
Every finding passes through the AI Council Conductor verification process:
Generator → Critic → Verifier → Refiner → Specialist
Operated by Ola Olaitan. More at aicouncilconductor.com
